### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/service-automation`, touching **5** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`  _(via AutomationServicePlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via AutomationServicePlugin (symbol, a top-level class), /api/v1/meta/connector/:name (route, a path literal in a comment in AutomationServicePlugin))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **10** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7a378234c8b44f98537900941f6ab06d6f1edbd2` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `df6e7936bf02bc5d4db63a0dcabbf3a79b968d4a` — the merge of head `89267c8b3ec2277857b466333136781016b023ba` into base `7a378234c8b44f98537900941f6ab06d6f1edbd2`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin df6e7936bf02bc5d4db63a0dcabbf3a79b968d4a && git checkout df6e7936bf02bc5d4db63a0dcabbf3a79b968d4a
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7a378234c8b44f98537900941f6ab06d6f1edbd2 89267c8b3ec2277857b466333136781016b023ba && git checkout -B drift-repro 7a378234c8b44f98537900941f6ab06d6f1edbd2 && git merge --no-ff 89267c8b3ec2277857b466333136781016b023ba

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7a378234c8b44f98537900941f6ab06d6f1edbd2
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 7a378234c8b44f98537900941f6ab06d6f1edbd2` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Seat ACCEPT · PR #28028 · head `89267c8b3ec2277857b466333136781016b023ba` · 2026-10-30T09:30Z

## 维护者速读

When one replica publishes, saves active, or deletes a connector definition, every replica now picks it up. Before, only the publishing replica rebuilt the instance, and peers kept the old one until a reload or a restart (measured on #27977). The automation plugin already received the change on every replica through lane 2 (`metadata.mutated`) but acted only on flows. It now queues the same connector reconcile a reload runs. No new cluster channel is added. A direct active `PUT /meta/connector/:name`, which raised no reload at all before, now also re-materialises the replica that wrote it.

## 席位核对

- **Shape:** draft → main, `Fixes #28002`, 3 files: `plugin.ts` (+46 / −2), the #27977 pin file (`it.fails` flipped to a plain `it`, with new pins), and a changeset (`@objectstack/service-automation` patch).
  - `check-governed-merges --pr 28028`: NOT governed, +196 / −19.
- **Read of the diff:** the mutation listener keeps its draft and empty-name early returns. A `connector` mutation queues `reconcileDeclaredConnectors(ctx, { fatal: false })` on the existing reconcile queue, coalesced by one pending flag, and `flow` is handled as before. A failed reconcile logs at `warn` and leaves the next reload or restart to retry. This follows triage 6517791280: lane 2, no new lane.
- **Double signal on the publisher:** a publish raises both `metadata:reloaded` and the mutation. The second reconcile finds every signature unchanged, so the provider is called once per changed definition (pinned). A held instance (#28014) is re-attempted only when its signature changes, so an unchanged mutation does not re-open a held retry.
- **Tests:** the #27977 gap now passes (the peer converges). A direct active save converges the writer and the peer, and a delete tears the instance down on both. Controls: a draft save and a mutation of another type run no reconcile. The card thread reports an ablation that reds 5 with 2 green, restored clean.
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, patch. No published face narrows, so no contract review is owed.
- **Skills-docs:** the PR body names `kernel/cluster.mdx` §6.2 (lane 2) and the `automation/connectors.mdx:458` reload row as a follow-up. That is carried by #28030, to be edited after this merges.
- **Local (card thread):** package suite 223 files and 2846 tests green, typecheck green, 59 of 60 derived gate families exit 0, with `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED locally (CI runs it), and `pnpm lint` exit 0.
- **Gate check-runs on this head:** 48 total, 35 success, 13 skipped by the path filter, 0 failed. `mergeable_state: clean`.
- **Landing:** Tier S, under the maintainer's landing grant for this term (2026-10-29 22:05Z, seat thread). Ready + auto-merge through the relay.

**ACCEPT**
